Check the parties’ key promises and policies Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast A Victorian Coalition government would privatise two sewage plants and sell off state-owned land, renewable energy assets and the “air rights” between Richmond train station and the Melbourne Cricket Ground if elected.
